packSplit.rule: Single fact source split into two Foundry packs. core = the eight core occupations plus the product-defined custom investigator; expand = every other shipped occupation. An expand profession may only be built while the arcane-investigator-options module is enabled; removing that module restores the core-only list. Each slug belongs to exactly one pack and the union is the whole file.

scope: M2 first-batch occupations; the M3 second batch (Doctor of Medicine, Police Detective, Librarian, Lawyer, Engineer); the M6 third batch (Police Officer, Artist, Clergy, Pilot); the M7 coc-cardwright batch; and the M8 sealdice-builtins compatibility batch: 118 SealDice builtin formal definitions mapped onto the same creation rules. Only the helpdoc's formula, credit-rating range and skill composition are used; every description is written for this project. Entries that are aliases, malformed, custom, not eight slots, missing a formula/credit range, or lacking a verified skill base are listed as deferred in provenance.json. The file stays a single fact source; every record carries `pack` and the build slices it into the core packs (coc-skills / coc-professions) and the optional expansion module (arcane-investigator-skills / arcane-investigator-professions).
